tools.name: list_tournaments
tools.description: Use to find tournaments. Lists a season's tournaments (ascending) or the latest ones (descending) with dates, status, purse, whether it is a major, the winner and winning score, field size and the courses. Filter by season, status and major. Costs 1 credit.

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.description: Use for what is on now and next: tournaments in play or starting in the next N days (default 30), with the courses and the defending champion. Costs 1 credit.

tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.description: Use for a tournament's results: every player in the field in finishing order with position (T5), status (cut, wd, dq), score to par, total strokes, each round's score and strokes versus the field, earnings and season points, plus any playoff. Costs 2 credits.

tools.name: get_course
tools.description: Use for a course as it was set up for a tournament: par and yards per hole, and how each hole played (scoring average, to par, birdie and bogey rates, difficulty rank) from every round on it. For a tournament on more than one course pass course_id. Costs 2 credits.

tools.name: search_players
tools.description: Use to find a player's id by name (accents optional). Returns country, tournaments played, wins and the seasons played. Costs 1 credit.

tools.name: get_player
tools.description: Use for a player's overview: profile, career totals (starts, wins, top tens, cuts, money, scoring average, strokes versus the field), our current rating, a line per season and the last ten results. Costs 5 credits.

tools.name: get_player_results
tools.description: Use for a player's tournament-by-tournament record: finish, score, earnings and each round with the field's average and strokes versus the field (raw and field-strength adjusted). Newest first; filter by season. Costs 5 credits.

tools.name: get_player_stats
tools.description: Use for a player's season in numbers: results (starts, wins, top tens, cuts, money), scoring average and strokes versus the field, hole scoring from every hole played (birdies and bogeys per round, par 3/4/5 averages) and, for the PGA Tour and Korn Ferry Tour, strokes versus the field by hole type (

tools.name: get_scorecard
tools.description: Use for one player's tournament hole by hole: every round's strokes on each hole with par, yards and the result (birdie, bogey), the course played, out and in, and strokes versus the field. Costs 2 credits.

tools.name: get_course_history
tools.description: Use for course or event form: a player's record at one tournament across every year (pass any edition's tournament_id) or at one course across every tournament played there (course_id), with finishes, rounds and strokes versus the field, and a summary. Costs 5 credits.

tools.name: get_head_to_head
tools.description: Use to compare two players: every tournament both played with each one's finish, who finished ahead (making the cut beats missing it), round-by-round strokes on the same course, and a summary. Filter by season. Costs 5 credits.

tools.name: get_ratings
tools.description: Use for who is playing best: our strokes-versus-field rating for every player active in the past year, best first.
